title: GTA 6 PS5 Physical Edition Includes a Poster, But Not the Map
description: Retailers shipping GTA 6 boxed copies confirm a double-sided A3 poster is included in the PS5 case, though it is still not the traditional game map.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 PS5 Physical Edition Includes a Poster, But It's Still Not the Map

As retailers begin the process of shipping out their boxed copies of *GTA 6*, new details regarding the contents of the physical game cases have emerged. While excitement reaches a fever pitch across the gaming community, early confirmations from inventory stock provide a clearer picture of what players will actually find inside the box.

### What's Inside the Box

According to reports from gaming media, as physical stock arrives and prepares for dispatch, it has now been confirmed that the PS5 retail cases do indeed contain a physical item. Specifically, players will find a two-sided A3 poster tucked inside the case alongside the other printed materials. 

However, it is worth noting for collectors that these boxed copies feature a digital download code rather than a physical disc, aligning with modern distribution trends for certain editions.

### The Absence of the Classic Game Map

Despite the inclusion of the A3 double-sided poster, there is one notable omission that traditional fans of the franchise might find disappointing. Historically, Rockstar Games has been famous for including a physical, detailed fold-out map of the game world with previous *GTA* and *Red Dead Redemption* releases. Unfolding the map to study the terrain before diving into the game has been a rite of passage for series veterans.

Based on current retail confirmations, the newly discovered poster is still not the map of the game world that previous *GTA* games have traditionally shipped with. Whether a physical map will be reserved for future special editions or if digital avenues will replace it remains to be seen as the launch unfolds.

### Editor's Take

For longtime fans who cherish the physical rituals of opening a new Rockstar game, finding a digital code and a poster instead of the iconic world map feels like the end of an era. While the A3 double-sided poster is a neat collector's bonus, the lack of the traditional map leaves a noticeable gap for physical edition purists.
